prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 49.8 °C (60% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 54.5 °C (51% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 56.1 °C (44% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.70 s (5% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.24 l/min (5% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 388 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.2 % (6% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Pressure stability and surge dampening meet full design specifications.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 49.6 °C (60% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 54.2 °C (51% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 55.7 °C (43% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.0 s (2% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.70 s (5% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.23 l/min (5% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 385 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.3 % (4% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.0 bar (within 1% of healthy). Circuit pressure ripple is minimal and peak buffering operates at optimal baseline.
